contexts.name: GitHub Evidence & CV Utilities
contexts.description: Pull GitHub repo evidence into a candidate analysis and auto-fill / vary CV-derived profile fields. Backs the GitHub analysis panel and CV provenance helpers.

contexts.name: Candidate Profile & Job Matching
contexts.description: Build a structured CandidateProfile from evidence and match one candidate against many jobs with deterministic scoring plus cached LLM reasoning. Covers Profile, Match, archetypes, and the candidate matrix.

contexts.name: Analysis Result Panels
contexts.description: The tabbed presentation of a completed analysis: extraction, salary gauge, job-fit skill chips + missing-skill tiers, interview kit, soft signals, and side-by-side comparison.

contexts.name: CV Analysis Workspace
contexts.description: Drop, paste, or upload a CV and a target JD, then run a full AI analysis. Drives the Analyze tab intake, file routing, and the analysis run lifecycle.

contexts.name: Sourcing, Campaigns & Rediscovery
contexts.description: Surface matching candidates for a role, run outreach campaigns, rediscover past applicants, and assess role winnability. Covers recruiter candidate pools and rediscovery alerts.

contexts.name: Job Postings & Lifecycle
contexts.description: Create, ingest, publish and close job postings and track their lifecycle. Covers the Jobs tab table, posting modal, ad ingestion and draft splitting.

contexts.name: JD Authoring Library & Templates
contexts.description: Author, lint, version and render job descriptions from reusable templates. Covers the Library tab, JD builder, template manager, and the public JD detail pages.

contexts.name: Communications & Inbound Channels
contexts.description: Outbound candidate communications (envelopes, dispatch, delivery status, resend) and inbound channel webhooks/tokens that feed applications into the pipeline.

contexts.name: Group Evaluation & Fairness
contexts.description: Side-by-side group evaluation of shortlisted candidates with per-candidate tabs, comparison tables, differentiators, risks and a fairness panel.

contexts.name: Screening Decisions & Records
contexts.description: Configure screening rules, run AI-assisted role decisions, reconsider candidates, and persist an auditable decision record. Covers the Decisions tab and decision config/attribution.

contexts.name: Application Intake & Apply Flows
contexts.description: Public candidate-facing apply experience: conversational and quick-apply forms, lead intake, application-status tracking, and completeness follow-ups.

contexts.name: Pipeline Board & Candidate Drawer
contexts.description: The kanban-style hiring pipeline: drag candidates across stages, open a candidate drawer with their full timeline and result, and stream live updates.

contexts.name: Interview Simulation & Comparison
contexts.description: Simulate an interview round, attach simulated outcomes to a candidate, compare interviews, and produce interview recommendations (incl. student mode).

contexts.name: Voice Interview
contexts.description: In-browser voice first-round interview with an AI agent (OpenAI Realtime / ElevenLabs switcher): create, connect, run, transcribe, and complete the session.

contexts.name: Interview Scheduling, Prep & Rubric
contexts.description: Send self-scheduling invites, pick slots across timezones, generate interview prep packs and rubrics, and track invite lifecycle and reminders.

contexts.name: Candidate Onboarding Hand-off
contexts.description: Post-Hired onboarding hand-off: a reusable checklist template per new hire, a pre-boarding entry questionnaire, and an audit-stamped e-sign provider seam. Covers the recruiter Onboarding tab plus the candidate-facing token-gated questionnaire reached from an accepted offer.

contexts.name: Hiring Automation & Scheduler
contexts.description: The background automation engine that advances the pipeline on a schedule: automation passes, fairness/ROI gating, cache keys, and the persistent scheduler. Includes the Python automation CLI/eval.

contexts.name: Offers & Onboarding
contexts.description: Generate, send, and finalize candidate offers via a tokenized public offer page, gated by offer policy.

contexts.name: Dev Case Pipeline (Python)
contexts.description: The Python engine behind dev cases: analyze a need, design a case, evaluate submissions, reflect, run lifecycle audits, and judge with an LLM. Backs the TS dev-hiring routes.

contexts.name: Dev Lifecycle, Cohort & Outcomes
contexts.description: Manage dev case lifecycle (approve/close/redesign), cohort probe strength, interview kits, skill-profile verification, outbox comms and hiring outcomes.

contexts.name: Dev Submissions & Live Work Surface
contexts.description: Candidate-facing dev case workspace (live coding surface, seed files) plus recruiter-side submission review, authenticity scoring, and side-by-side submission comparison.

contexts.name: Dev Case Authoring & Publishing
contexts.description: Author developer hiring cases from a role need, generate/orchestrate the case content, and publish postings with apply tokens. Covers the Dev tab and case orchestration.

contexts.name: Pipeline Test Suite (Python)
contexts.description: The pytest suite that quality-gates the Python engine: matching, profiling, taxonomy contracts, fairness, devcase, LLM layer, salary/score sanity, and prompt-version sync.

contexts.name: Evaluation, Fairness & Seed Data
contexts.description: Offline evaluation harness (thresholds, matching/automation eval, fixtures) and the deterministic seed datasets for jobs (Česká spořitelna), candidates, pipeline, analyses and salary benchmarks.

contexts.name: Pipeline CLIs & Script Bridges
contexts.description: Command-line entry points that the Next.js API shells out to (analyze, profile, match, reasoning, jobs, recruiter, matrix, salary, campaign, winnability) plus the thin scripts/ wrappers.

contexts.name: CV Extraction & Pipeline Services
contexts.description: Parse and extract structure from CVs via Gemini, score soft signals, run the analysis pipeline orchestration and the long-running service, with redaction and i18n of prompts.

contexts.name: Matching & Transformation Engine
contexts.description: The deterministic scoring core: taxonomy, archetypes, skill transformation/transferability, candidate↔job matching, reasoning prep, recruiter scoring, insights and winnability.

contexts.name: Model & API Key Management
contexts.description: Configure which LLM models/providers power the app and securely store provider API keys, with a connectivity test and engine-availability preflight.

contexts.name: LLM Provider Layer (Python)
contexts.description: Provider-agnostic LLM abstraction: a registry + capabilities, per-provider adapters (Anthropic, OpenAI, Azure, Gemini), monitoring, and a benchmarking harness.

contexts.name: Guided Pipeline Simulation
contexts.description: A keyless, guided JD→Hired demo that drives real clicks through the app with a bottom bar, spotlight, explain drawer, group-eval and offer frames.

contexts.name: Architecture Diagrams
contexts.description: The interactive pipeline/architecture diagrams page and the custom PlantUML-style Markdown renderer (elkjs layout) that draws component diagrams as styled SVG.

contexts.name: Skill Matrix & Coverage
contexts.description: The candidate↔skill matrix view and the About/coverage explainer that maps features to the pipeline (incl. student mode).

contexts.name: Analytics & Calibration Dashboards
contexts.description: Funnel analytics, decision logs/records, spend and target tracking, calibration of scores, momentum/forecast/bottleneck deltas, and source analytics.

contexts.name: Plans, Checkout & Billing UI
contexts.description: The Billing tab where users view their plan, start checkout, and open the customer portal.

contexts.name: Billing Engine & Webhooks
contexts.description: Entitlement enforcement and the billing gateway (Polar): plan reduction, entitlement checks, webhook verification/sync. Gates premium capabilities across the app.

contexts.name: Landing & Marketing
contexts.description: The public marketing landing pages (Studio + Spark art directions) and the login entry page.

contexts.name: Shared Utility Libraries
contexts.description: Cross-cutting low-level utilities: caching, logging, env parsing, rate limiting, URL/ID safety, API response shaping, dedupe and distribution math.

contexts.name: Shared UI & Design System
contexts.description: Reusable behavioral primitives and the dual-theme (Studio Light / Spark Dark) design system: Modal, Badge, SegmentedControl, recipes, theme tokens, icons and score visuals.

contexts.name: Tasks & System Operations
contexts.description: The background task tracker (provider, indicator, tasks tab), system/backup cards, health and ops telemetry, and the Python runner bridge.

contexts.name: App Shell & Navigation
contexts.description: The authenticated workspace shell: tab navigation, command palette, keyboard shortcuts, recents, global search, attention badges, live refresh, and i18n.

contexts.name: Privacy, Consent & Provenance
contexts.description: GDPR-oriented consent capture and gating, AI-usage disclosure to candidates, and the provenance dossier that records how each data point was derived.

contexts.name: Data Store & Persistence
contexts.description: The SQLite persistence foundation: the core DB handle/connection, generated and hand-written schemas, the null contract, and DB path/portability helpers shared by every feature store.

contexts.name: Auth, Sessions & Workspace Tenancy
contexts.description: Login/logout sessions, edge token verification, multi-workspace switching/tenancy scoping, and workspace export/import (data portability).
